cases.name: fixed_step
cases.description: The plank press and a connection moment just past their safe limits, stepped at 30, 60, 120 and 240 Hz, where 240 Hz is the 60 Hz tick with four substeps. Constant-strength fallback work integrates linearly. Cumulative work and integrity after 1/30 s match at every rate; failure lands within one tick (plus f32 rounding) of the analytic time. Event columns describe only the tick ending at 1/30 s; cumulative work is explicitly separate.
